create_google_test_format: create a GoogleTest TestFormat instance with test sub directories and test suffix configuration
discover_gtest_tests: discover google test names from a gtest executable by parsing --gtest_list_tests output
run_gtest_tests_in_directory: run gtest tests in a directory by discovering executables and yielding individual test cases
execute_gtest_with_filter: execute a single gtest with --gtest_filter and return pass, fail, timeout, or unresolved status
add_python_to_command: add the python executable to a command list when the script ends with .py
